title: Hearty Flaky Norwegian Mushroom Onigiri
description: A rich and flaky Norwegian dish featuring mushrooms, shaped into nigiri, and suitable for a keto-friendly diet
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the mushrooms in coconut oil until they are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, egg, cream cheese, cheddar cheese, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the sauteed mushrooms to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a nigiri shape.
Place the shaped onigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the onigiri in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Remove the onigiri from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
